description: E-19 (ADR-0013 §8/§12). How the evaluator treats jurisdiction packs. The evaluator hard-codes NO local legal assumption (no 'outside city limits means no licence'): everything it concludes comes from a cited pack. Absence of a pack is UNKNOWN, never 'no licence needed'. Uncertainty only ever KEEPS a credential requirement; it can never remove one. All numbers are REC priors.

staleness.note: age of date_verified: <= fresh_days: full confidence; <= stale_days: x0.7; <= expired_days: x0.4; beyond expired_days the pack is EXPIRED_PACK => UNKNOWN

gate.note: A sample/fixture pack is never authoritative: its result may not unblock a job.
